name: Parse.ly
description: Query Parse.ly content analytics using the same top content, referrers, real-time traffic, and conversion data your editorial and marketing teams already trust, directly from Claude. Instantly answer questions about what your audience is reading, sharing, and converting on using natural language — no need to build dashboards or export CSVs. Your Parse.ly account becomes Claude's knowledge of your content performance, enabling fast, accurate answers scoped to the sites and publishers you already have access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Parse.ly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Parse.ly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dash.parsely.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Parse.ly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parse.ly lists 35 MCP tools, including create_aspect_group, delete_aspect_group, get_aspect_group, get_campaign, get_site_overview, get_user, list_aspect_group, list_author, list_section, list_site, list_tag, and query_apple_discovery_source.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Parse.ly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Parse.ly in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Parse.ly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Parse.ly is developed by Parse.ly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
